name: feeblemind
lore:
# On the Hollow Curse: Feeblemind

To cast *Feeblemind* is to commit an act of intellectual vivisection. When shaping the Weave, the caster feels a brittle, jagged tension, as if pulling a single, vital thread from a complex tapestry until the entire pattern snaps. It is a cold, sharp sensation—the magical equivalent of a sudden frost shattering a delicate crystal.

Visually, the spell manifests as a blinding, violet strobe that lances toward the victim’s brow. In that instant, the light in the target’s eyes doesn't merely dim; it evaporates, leaving behind a vacant, glassy stare that reflects nothing but the void.

Chronicles trace its origin to the Spite-Mage Kaelen. Seeking to silence a rival philosopher without the mess of martyrdom, Kaelen sought a way to "unmake the man while leaving the meat." He spent years observing the mindless beasts of the Abyss, eventually distilling their hollow stupor into this singular, cruel incantation. To the victim, the world becomes a roar of incomprehensible shapes; to the witness, it is the most silent of tragedies.
